name: fireblooded-oath-class-bonus-banishes-three-fire-cards-then-levels-up
notes: Regression: the printed additional cost (banish three fire element cards from your graveyard) was never paid, so the Oath levelled the champion up for free and kept the graveyard.

rulesClauses: As an additional cost to activate this card, banish three fire element cards from your graveyard.
